input: Create a tar.gz archive of the /project directory and save it as /tmp/project.tar.gz. Then create /backup directory and extract the archive there. Verify the files exist in /backup.

transcript.final_response:
All tasks completed successfully:

1. **Created tar.gz archive** of `/project` saved as `/tmp/project.tar.gz` (232 bytes):
   - `tar -czf /tmp/project.tar.gz -C / project`
   - Archive contains: `project/`, `project/README.md`, `project/src/`, `project/src/main.sh`

2. **Created /backup directory and extracted archive**:
   - `mkdir -p /backup && tar -xzf /tmp/project.tar.gz -C /backup`

3. **Verified files exist in /backup**:
   - `/backup/project/README.md` exists and matches original
   - `/backup/project/src/main.sh` exists and matches original
   - `/backup` directory structure mirrors `/project`
tool_calls: ls -la /project 2>&1; echo "---"; ls -la /tmp 2>&1; echo "---"; ls -la /backup 2>&1 || echo "/backup does not exist"
tar -czf /tmp/project.tar.gz -C / project && echo "archive created" && ls -lh /tmp/project.tar.gz && tar -tzf /tmp/project.tar.gz

mkdir -p /backup && tar -xzf /tmp/project.tar.gz -C /backup && echo "extraction done" && ls -laR /backup && echo "---VERIFY---" && ls -lh /tmp/project.tar.gz /backup && test -f /backup/project/README.md && test -f /backup/project/src/main.sh && echo "VERIFIED: files exist in /backup" && diff -r /project /backup/project && echo "DIFF OK: /backup matches /project"

echo "=== /tmp/project.tar.gz ===" && ls -lh /tmp/project.tar.gz && echo "=== /backup contents ===" && ls -laR /backup && echo "=== file checks ===" && test -f /backup/project/README.md && echo "OK: /backup/project/README.md exists" && test -f /backup/project/src/main.sh && echo "OK: /backup/project/src/main.sh exists" && echo "=== content comparison ===" && diff /project/README.md /backup/project/README.md && echo "README.md matches" && diff /project/src/main.sh /backup/project/src/main.sh && echo "main.sh matches" && echo "ALL VERIFIED"
